map.无障碍卫生间设施尺寸规范速查，含平面布局示意，辅助设计与验收: Quick reference for accessible restroom facility dimensions, with layout diagrams, for design and acceptance
map.无障碍卫生间关键尺寸（扶手高度、回转直径、门净宽、坐便器高度等）与设计要点速查，: A quick reference for the key dimensions of an accessible restroom (grab bar height, turning diameter, clear door width, toilet height, etc.) and design essentials, assisting accessible environment design and acceptance. Pure front-end local reference, no data uploaded.
map.家庭适老化改造：为腿脚不便老人改造卫生间，按本工具核对坐便器高度 0.45m、两: Home aging-in-place renovation: renovate the bathroom for elderly people with limited mobility, and check with this tool that the toilet height is 0.45m, the L-shaped grab bars on both sides are 0.70m above the floor, and the turning diameter is ≥1.50m, so the renovation does not still fall short after completion.
map.公共建筑设计：公厕设无障碍厕位，使用面积≥4.00m²（2m×2m 以上）、门洞: Public building design: public toilets provide an accessible stall, with a use area of ≥4.00m² (2m×2m or more), a clear door opening of ≥0.80m, a wash basin height of 0.80m with ≥0.60m clear space below, satisfying GB 55019-2021.
map.工程验收：对照内置 14 项验收清单逐项核查（门内外无高差或≤15mm 斜面过渡: Engineering acceptance: check the 14 built-in acceptance items one by one (no level difference inside and outside the door or a transition ramp ≤15mm, anti-slip floor class C, call button 0.40~0.50m above the floor, etc.), and export the checklist in one click for archiving.
map.算例：某卫生间实测核查: Example: measured check of a restroom
map.实测某卫生间平面 1.8m×1.9m=3.42m²（<4.00m² 不达标）、门: A measured restroom plan of 1.8m×1.9m=3.42m² (<4.00m², not compliant), a door opening of 0.75m (<0.80m, not compliant), and a turning area of 1.2m square (diameter about 1.20m < 1.50m, not compliant). None of the three satisfies GB 55019-2021, so the use area must be expanded to at least 4.00m², the door opening widened, and wheelchair turning space guaranteed; otherwise the acceptance will not pass.
map.无障碍卫生间最小面积要求是多少？: What is the minimum area requirement for an accessible restroom?
map.依据《建筑与市政工程无障碍通用规范》GB 55019-2021，无障碍卫生间使用: Under "General Code for Accessibility of Buildings and Municipal Engineering" GB 55019-2021, the use area of an accessible restroom should not be less than 4.00m² (2m×2m or more is recommended), and a wheelchair turning space of diameter ≥1.50m must be ensured; the clear door opening is ≥0.80m, with the door opening outward or sliding.
map.扶手安装有哪些要点？: What are the key points for grab bar installation?
map.坐便器两侧应设 L 形或水平扶手，安装高度距地 0.70m、长度≥0.70m；扶: L-shaped or horizontal grab bars should be provided on both sides of the toilet, installed at a height of 0.70m above the floor with a length of ≥0.70m; grab bars should be firm and anti-slip, with a diameter of 30~40mm for easy gripping; the wash basin height is 0.80m, and lever or sensor faucets are preferred.
map.无障碍卫生间关键尺寸与设计要点速查，辅助无障碍环境设计与验收，数据全部本地处理、: A quick reference for the key dimensions and design essentials of an accessible restroom, assisting accessible environment design and acceptance, with all data processed locally and never uploaded.
map.按无障碍卫生间规范渲染示意图与清单：外墙画成 480 × 300 的矩形框，底部: Render the schematic and checklist per accessible-restroom standards: draw the outer wall as a 480 × 300 rectangle, cut an 80 px doorway at the bottom with a 40-radius outward opening arc and label the clear door width ≥ 0.80 m; draw a 75-radius turning circle at the center labelled turning diameter ≥ 1.50 m; place the toilet against the left wall with a 0.70 m high grab bar on the right; put the washbasin in the top-right corner labelled 0.80 m high; overall width ≥ 2.00 m and depth ≥ 2.00 m. Each acceptance item is rendered as a checkbox, and export joins lines as "checkbox + item"
map.按所选地区与项目类型渲染示意图和清单：中国大陆默认按 GB 55019-2021: Render the diagram and checklist for the selected region and project type: China defaults to GB 55019-2021 labels — clear door width ≥0.80 m, turning φ1.5 m, grab bar 0.70 m, lavatory 0.80 m, width/depth ≥2.00 m; the US switches to ADA labels of 32 in / 60 in / 33–36 in / ≤34 in / 60 in; other regions show only “follow local code” and do not provide values ready for acceptance. The diagram is proportional only and its labels switch with the region; it is not a dimensional basis. Each checklist item provides a verification status (pending / pass / fail / not applicable) and a note field; export copies text containing the region, project type, basis, limits, verification date and per-item status, and does not generate a formal report.

map.本页把不同地区/版本的无障碍卫生间尺寸汇总为一张示意清单，: This page consolidates accessible-restroom dimensions from different regions and versions into one indicative checklist,
map.。中国项目应查阅项目所在地现行《建筑与市政工程无障碍通用规范》GB 55019-: . China projects should consult the current “General Code for Accessibility of Buildings and Municipal Engineering” GB 55019-2021 and its applicable clauses; GB 50763-2012 is an earlier version and is only for comparison — whether it is adopted by a locality or project must be verified. US projects follow ADA 2010 Standards, and the inch and metric provisions are not one-to-one equivalents. The values below are for discussion/self-check only; before implementation, a qualified professional must review them against the current code text, design documents and site conditions (page verification date 2026-11-25).
map.中国大陆公共建筑：选“中国大陆 / 公共建筑”，尺寸卡片按 GB 55019-2: China mainland / public building: select “China mainland / Public building”; the dimension cards show GB 55019-2021 values — clear door width ≥0.80 m, turning φ1.50 m, grab bar 0.70 m, lavatory 0.80 m — and the checklist uses the same values. Exported text carries the region, project type, basis, limits and page verification date.
map.美国项目：选“美国”后，卡片与示意图切换为 ADA 的 32in/60in/33: US project: after selecting “United States”, the cards and diagram switch to ADA labels of 32 in / 60 in / 33–36 in / ≤34 in / 60 in and the checklist uses inch-based provisions; the page notes that metric conversions cannot replace the ADA text and that state/local codes may be stricter.
map.其他地区或住宅改造：选“其他地区”时卡片只显示“按当地规范”，不提供可直接验收数: Other regions or home renovation: selecting “Other regions” shows only “follow local code” on the cards and provides no values ready for acceptance; selecting “Home aging-in-place renovation” appends door-opening modification, emergency call and caregiver trial items, which are also included in the export.
map.算例：中国大陆公共建筑 vs 美国: Example: China mainland public building vs United States
map.中国大陆/公共建筑：门洞净宽卡片显示“≥ 0.80m”，回转空间“φ ≥ 1.5: China mainland / public building: the clear-door-width card shows “≥ 0.80 m” and the turning space “φ ≥ 1.50 m”; checklist item 1 is “clear door width ≥ 0.80 m, door opens outward or slides”. After switching to the United States, the same positions become “≥ 32 in (0.815 m)” and “φ ≥ 60 in (1.525 m)”, the checklist changes to “clear width after door opens ≥ 32 in (0.815 m)”, and the page notes that ADA uses inch provisions and metric conversions are for comparison only.
map.算例：记录逐项核验并复制: Example: record per-item results and copy
map.在清单第 1 项选择“符合”、备注填“现场实测 0.82m”，第 2 项选择“不: Set checklist item 1 to “Pass” with the note “measured 0.82 m on site”, and item 2 to “Fail” with the note “20 mm threshold height difference”. Click “Copy current verification checklist”; the copied text contains the project location, project type, applicable code, page verification date, limits, plus “☑ clear door width… | verification: pass | note: measured 0.82 m on site” and “✗ no level difference inside/outside the door… | verification: fail | note: 20 mm threshold height difference”.
map.为什么切换地区后尺寸变了？: Why do the dimensions change when I switch regions?
map.不同地区的规范体系和数值不同。中国大陆默认按 GB 55019-2021；美国切: Different regions use different code systems and values. China mainland defaults to GB 55019-2021; the United States switches to the inch-based ADA 2010 Standards (metric conversions are shown); for other regions this page does not have the local current provisions, so it lists only check topics, shows “follow local code” and provides no values ready for acceptance. Each project still needs a qualified professional to confirm against the current text.
map.导出的清单能直接当验收报告吗？: Can the exported checklist be used directly as an acceptance report?
map.不能。按钮只把当前页面文本复制到剪贴板，不生成正式报告；复制内容包含地区、项目类: No. The button only copies the current page text to the clipboard and does not generate a formal report. The copied text includes the region, project type, basis, limits, page verification date and per-item status, but the values remain indicative for discussion/self-check; before implementation and acceptance, a qualified professional must review them against the current code text, design documents and site conditions.
map.每项后面的“待核验/符合/不符合/不适用”有什么用？: What are the “pending / pass / fail / not applicable” statuses for?
map.用于记录本次自查的逐项结果。选择状态并可填写备注，点“复制当前核验清单”时会把状: They record the per-item result of this self-check. Choose a status and optionally add a note; “Copy current verification checklist” carries both into the copied text for archiving or hand-off to a reviewer. They do not change the code values in the checklist and do not represent a formal acceptance conclusion.
